remarks: Conveniently located within walking distance to the beach, this refreshed ranch-style apartment is perfect for those who value both comfort and accessibility. Ideal for commuters, you'll be just moments away from I-95 and public transportation, while also being a short drive from the Chelsea Piers Athletic Facility and downtown Stamford. This spacious unit features two bright bedrooms and 1.5 well-appointed bathrooms. The updated kitchen comes fully equipped with quartz countertops, a new stove, and a microwave. The large living room and dining area provide plenty of space for relaxation and entertaining, complemented by new carpets throughout and abundant closet space. This apartment boasts a range of convenient amenities designed to enhance your living experience. Enjoy easy access with an elevator, making it simple to navigate the building. The in-unit washer and dryer add to the convenience of daily living, while the assigned parking space under the building ensures secure parking for your vehicle. Additional outdoor parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis, with plans for repaving in the spring to enhance the area. This apartment boasts a range of convenient amenities designed to enhance your living experience. Plus, you'll have your own private storage area, offering extra space for belongings and keeping your living area clutter-free.
